name: Boundary Sampling Methods
definition: A category of physics-based differentiable rendering (PBDR) methods that handle discontinuities in the integrand by partitioning the domain and explicitly sampling geometric boundaries (edges) where discontinuities occur, rather than reparameterizing the integral domain.
summary: Boundary sampling methods compute gradients for differentiable rendering by partitioning the domain and explicitly sampling geometric edges where discontinuities occur, rather than reparameterizing the integral.
